posts.en:
dsh-fabric is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Unifies every DSH extensibility seam behind one declarative DSL: a runtime `fabric` service, `fabric_extend`/`fabric_inspect` tools, and a capability-graph settings page.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3c1742a0549f99d3dc16.html
